# was derived from

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/wasDerivedFrom>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/provenance`](../../slices/provenance.md)

Relates a derived thing to the thing it was derived from — e.g. a text extraction, summary, or embedding to its source; a commit to its parent commit; a trajectory to its sample stream. The derivation's confidence and generating agent are recorded with [`gmeow:confidence`](gmeow-confidence.md) and [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md). Domain-free so that events, endurants, and information objects may all participate in derivation chains.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md) when the definition matches the source fact. Prefer a narrower GMEOW term when one exists, and keep projection concerns in the mapping layer.
